method.description: All ordered seat assignments for each seeded deal, sequentially on one host. Same-turn Normal comparison on post-opening Hard positions. Original submitted plans are checked before the reducer can turn a rejected plan into a draw. No bot strategy is modified.

limitations: Node timing on this CPU is not physical iPhone/iPad performance.
30 distinct deals per format; seat-swapped rounds sharing a deal are correlated.
Time-bounded search may choose different moves under different host load; seeded deals alone do not reproduce scores exactly.
A bot round win is not a measurement of human enjoyment or beginner accessibility.
This sample does not cover four-player games or long multi-round matches.
